title: PointView phone → laptop sample
description: One sample from the iPhone pointer, sent about 60 times per second as a WebSocket text frame. See docs/phone-protocol.md.

t_ms.description: Phone clock when the motion sample was taken, ms since the Unix epoch (Date.now()).

quat.description: Phone attitude [w, x, y, z]: rotates phone-frame vectors (x right edge, y top edge, z out of screen) into a gravity-aligned reference frame (z up, arbitrary yaw). Unit norm (±1e-3).

omega.description: Rotation rate [x, y, z] in rad/s, in the phone frame.

heading_deg.description: True heading of the top edge, degrees clockwise from north (magnetic if true is unavailable). null if unknown.

heading_acc.description: Heading accuracy, degrees. null if unknown.

gps_acc.description: Horizontal accuracy, meters. null if no fix.

buttons.description: Buttons pressed since the previous message, in order. Usually empty.

layers.description: Optional layer toggles. Omitted = unchanged since the last message (all on at start). aircraft/satellites/vessels/events are the God's Eye View live layers.

look.description: Optional God's Eye View sensor look. Omitted = unchanged ("normal" at start).

passthrough.description: Optional: show the VITURE camera image behind the overlay. Omitted = unchanged (false at start).
